narrative.overview:
The site is one index folio on a soft dark stage. Charcoal wraps a single warm paper sheet; identity is the cover, work is indexed plates. There is no centered hero stack of equal cards — hairline rules and course bands carry hierarchy instead.

Density stays calm and editorial. Motion shares one clock so hover, crossfade, and settle feel like the same instrument. Orange exists only to mark the active index course; it never paints the stage.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal stage with one centered warm sheet
Bricolage Grotesque display / Geist body pairing
Numbered index rows that drive a dark face-out plate at the fold
Floating charcoal pill nav fixed to the stage
Stamp CTAs with a slight hover rotation; no card shells

rules.name: The Active-Mark Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on the active index number, its course bar, focus outline, and the matching face-out number — never as a page wash, hero fill, or decorative accent cluster.

rules.name: The Two-Field Rule
rules.body: Content lives on the warm sheet; the charcoal stage is atmosphere and frame, not a second content surface.

rules.name: The Cover-First Rule
rules.body: On Home, the name in display type is the dominant signal; role and supporting line stay subordinate in soft ink.

rules.name: The No-Card-Shell Rule
rules.body: Do not wrap content in bordered, radius’d, shadow’d cards. Structure with hairline rules, course bands, and the single sheet.

dos: Do keep orange on active index signals and focus only.
Do structure lists with hairline rules and numbered courses on one sheet.
Do share the 420ms / cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) clock; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do put primary actions in stamp outlines, not filled brand buttons.
donts: Don't introduce equal card grids or competing surface shells on the sheet.
Don't wash the stage or sheet with mark orange.
Don't center a marketing hero stack above a card grid — identity stays cover-scale on the sheet.
Don't invent employers, metrics, or testimonials as real; keep provisional copy labeled.
